title: Vending Services Program Service Response, Included Calls and Uptime Schedule
content:
The response window within which a logged service call is attended, the number of service calls included without charge each year, the charge for a service call beyond that count, the machine availability the programme guarantees and the credit for each day a machine stands out of service are all printed against the programme the Vending Services Program agreement is written at.

| Programme | Response window | Service calls included without charge each year | Charge for a call beyond the included count | Guaranteed machine availability | Credit for each machine for each day out of service |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Single Machine Snack Service | 72 hours | 2 | 95.00 | 94.00 percent | 6.00 |
| Snack & Cold Beverage Bank | 48 hours | 4 | 110.00 | 95.50 percent | 9.00 |
| Combination Vending Bank | 24 hours | 8 | 125.00 | 97.00 percent | 14.00 |
| Fresh Food Vending Service | 12 hours | 12 | 145.00 | 98.00 percent | 22.00 |
| Campus Vending Network Service | 8 hours | 40 | 165.00 | 98.50 percent | 18.00 |
| Managed Vending & Kiosk Service | 6 hours | 26 | 185.00 | 99.20 percent | 28.00 |

The response window is stated in hours. The included-call count is a whole number of calls in a year. The call-out charge and the outage credit are amounts in US dollars, the credit being stated for one machine for one day. The availability figure is a percentage of the estate's opening hours.

### The schedule restated

The response window tightens as the programme grows, from 72 hours on the Single Machine Snack Service down to 6 hours on the Managed Vending & Kiosk Service, and the guaranteed availability rises across the same span, from 94.00 percent to 99.20 percent. The charge for a call beyond the included count rises steadily with the programme, from 95.00 to 185.00. Neither the included-call count nor the daily outage credit moves in step with programme rank: the largest included count, 40 calls, and a daily credit of 18.00 belong to the Campus Vending Network Service, while the Managed Vending & Kiosk Service carries 26 included calls and the largest daily credit at 28.00.

### Points of judgement on the two charges

The call-out charge and the outage credit run in opposite directions and are separate figures. The call-out charge is an amount the client is charged, stated for one call beyond the included count for the year. The outage credit is an amount credited to the client, stated for one machine and one day the machine stands out of service. On the Fresh Food Vending Service they are 145.00 and 22.00 respectively, and neither figure is derived from the other.
